introHtml: Ceramic personal care items bring a natural, tactile quality to your branded giveaways. Whether you choose a classic 17 oz Gale Ceramic Mug for morning coffee or a Modern Sprout® Garden Vibes Candle/Planter for desk-friendly relaxation, ceramic surfaces hold vibrant full-color logos and intricate designs. These items feel substantial in hand and resist wear, making them ideal for employee appreciation gifts or client thank-you packages that get daily use.
